The four formal resolutions apply to the same single-bridge prepared organization, full thirty-state model, equal node measure, specified native rows, positive fixed kappa, fixed mean-capacity leaf and structural clock. P1 has a complete event-free three-row causal law. Primitive data, independent storage/work/transport premises and derived pressure, phase row, conservation and response remain distinct. Registered actions and their occurrence are outside the consumed mechanisms, and finite UM is not identified with continuous transport.

P2 retains all predictive state and associations, with exact relative quotient plus origin reconstruction and proved regular all-forward continuation locally. Receiver readings and regional totals are not substituted for state, and the held-capacity runtime executor is not represented as an implementation of the joint law.

P3 defines a prepared identity independently of diagnostic extrema and proves local retention, recovery and transient internal receiver response under joint perturbations. It neither requires nor asserts acquisition, permanent periodic activity or a numerical basin for this accepted claim.

P4 compares matched held/dynamic capacity and equal/degree-weighted transport while preserving passive, capacity-mediated, sine and hybrid alternative domains. Shared recovery, storage signs or tangents do not select a unique constitutive law.

The receiver form/phase response, not the entire state, first distinguishes dynamic from matched held capacity at third order. Transmission is already present at second order, while the full capacity state can differ at first order.

The certified T=32 endpoint lies in the reflected capture domain and is not silently declared to be a full-state dynamic-capacity neighborhood.
